dimensions.name: Relationship recovery under a prescribed specification
dimensions.justification: Track A - prescribed specification, sim arm only. Unchanged from the baseline: RMSE(mu) 0.056 (SE 0.003) and RMSE(log sigma) 0.014 (0.002), better than the classical GAMLSS-style comparator (0.123, 0.043). The x3 slopes are recovered at 1.458 and -1.035 against the true 1.5 and -1.0. The fix PRs touch the discovery path, not the known-specification fits, so this dimension does not move. Anchor 4 is not assigned: the prescribed formula leaves no open structure to validate.

dimensions.name: Relationship discovery from data alone
dimensions.justification: Track B - data and response name only. sim is unchanged: location precision 0.980, recall 1.000 (x3-by-g in 10/10), scale precision and recall 1.000 (x5), zero false discoveries among x6/x7/x8, zero traps, Gaussian in 10/10. The real SLID arm no longer collapses: discovery now infers Gaussian and returns a non-empty model on 10/10 seeds, so the stated reason for withholding anchor 4 (the real-data arm collapses) is removed. Anchor 4 stays unassigned because the study still rests on one planted-truth DGP family and does not publish recovery rates across several structure types.

dimensions.name: Experimental iteration speed
dimensions.justification: Iteration speed is essentially unchanged and slightly faster throughout. Sim (3000x8): the known-spec LSS fit is 0.264 s median (p90 0.304) and a drop-one what-if 0.228 s; discovery 3.225 s median and 2.364 s per what-if. SLID (2007x4): known 0.140 s and 0.107 s. SLID discovery is the one visible move in this dimension: 1.137 s per fit, down from the baseline's 1.840 s, and 0.666 s per what-if down from 1.106 s, because the Gaussian family now selected converges faster than the divergent Gamma did. Seconds per fit leave this at anchor 3; anchor 4's sub-second refits hold for the known-spec path only.

dimensions.name: Uncertainty honesty (calibration)
dimensions.justification: Calibration is unchanged where it was good and repaired on the one track that failed. sim known: 95% coverage 0.9481 (gap -0.19 pp, SE 0.13), 80% 0.7979 (-0.21 pp, 0.27). SLID known: 0.9548 (+0.48 pp, 0.19) and 0.8119 (+1.19 pp, 0.50). SLID discovery, which undercovered at 0.716 (gap -8.4 pp) when it returned the intercept-only model, now covers 0.8037 (gap +0.37 pp, SE 0.47) at 80% and 0.9499 (-0.01 pp) at 95%. Anchor 4 is not assigned: small-n and extrapolation adaptation are not measured.

dimensions.name: Predictive validity
dimensions.justification: Primary loss is the Gaussian CRPS; the best competitor is a per-seed retrospective best and comparator settings are untuned. sim is unchanged: known -4.56% (SE 0.16), discovery -4.44% (0.16); RMSE -1.02% and -0.99%. SLID known is unchanged at +0.58% (0.13) CRPS, inside the 1% goal. SLID discovery moves from +34.07% (0.47) to +1.15% (0.17) CRPS, and from +28.76% (0.42) to +0.85% (0.15) RMSE: the intercept-only model is gone. Anchor 4 is not assigned because tuning and compute budgets are not matched across the comparator field.
